crew.original_title: 劇場版「鬼滅の刃」無限列車編
crew.overview: Tanjiro Kamado, joined with Inosuke Hashibira, a boy raised by boars who wears a boar's head, and Zenitsu Agatsuma, a scared boy who reveals his true power when he sleeps, boards the Infinity Train on a new mission with the Fire Hashira, Kyojuro Rengoku, to defeat a demon who has been tormenting the people and killing the demon slayers who oppose it!
crew.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train

crew.original_title: ドラゴンボール超 ブロリー
crew.overview: Earth is peaceful following the Tournament of Power. Realizing that the universes still hold many more strong people yet to see, Goku spends all his days training to reach even greater heights. Then one day, Goku and Vegeta are faced by a Saiyan called 'Broly' who they've never seen before. The Saiyans were supposed to have been almost completely wiped out in the destruction of Planet Vegeta, so what's this one doing on Earth? This encounter between the three Saiyans who have followed completely different destinies turns into a stupendous battle, with even Frieza (back from Hell) getting caught up in the mix.
crew.title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly

details.biography: Ken Arto (アルト健, Aruto Ken), real name Pierre-Éric Artaud, is a French animator. He started as an in-between animator in 2015 for Studio Graphinica and is now a key animator working for Studio 4C. His mother is Japanese, so he has used the pseudonym Ken Sugita (杉田健) on rare occasions.
details.name: Ken Arto
